phases.title: Implement filterProducts in src/utils/productFilters.ts
phases.notes: Implemented search (case-insensitive trim), category (All = no filter), inStockOnly, and sort (price-asc, price-desc, rating-desc) without mutating input. Build passes. Remaining test failures are in phases 2-3 (UI handlers still stubbed).

phases.title: Wire up event handlers in src/components/FilterPanel.tsx
phases.notes: Wired search input, category dropdown, inStockOnly checkbox, and Clear filters button to call onChange. Reset values use the same defaults as initialFilters in useProductFilters (sortBy:'default'). Filtering and clearFilters tests all pass. Build passes. Sorting tests still fail — SortSelect not yet wired (phase-3).

phases.title: Wire up onChange handler in src/components/SortSelect.tsx
phases.notes: Renamed _onChange to onChange and wired the select's onChange to call onChange(e.target.value). All 17 tests pass, build succeeds.

phases.title: Wrap setFilters in App.tsx to reset page to 1 on filter change
phases.notes: Added handleFiltersChange wrapper (calls setFilters + setPage(1)) passed to FilterPanel. Updated SortSelect inline lambda to also call setPage(1). All 17 tests pass, build succeeds.

phases.title: Run tests and verify build passes
phases.notes: All 17 tests pass (6 test files). Build succeeds with tsc -b and vite build producing dist/ artifacts.
